Location: Welshpool, Western Australia 6106
Employment Type: Full-Time
Salary: $90,000 – $120,000 per annum (depending on skills and experience)

MINPROVISE INTERNATIONAL PTY LTD is a leading total solutions provider delivering specialist maintenance and shutdown services, engineering, fabrication, project services, and sustaining capital works. We also provide a comprehensive range of equipment and products, supporting the mining, oil & gas, and construction industries across Australia and internationally.

We are currently seeking an experienced and motivated Contract Administrator to join our growing team on a full-time basis.
About the Role

As a Contract Administrator, you will be responsible for administering commercial contracts and providing contractual support across engineering, mining, maintenance, shutdown, and construction projects. You will work closely with project managers, engineers, procurement teams, subcontractors, and clients to ensure contracts are managed effectively, project risks are minimised, and contractual obligations are met.

Key Responsibilities
•	Prepare, review, and administer contracts, subcontracts, and service agreements in accordance with company policies and project requirements.
•	Monitor contract performance to ensure compliance with contractual terms, specifications, budgets, and project schedules.
•	Assist in preparing tender documentation, contract variations, extensions of time, and claims.
•	Coordinate the execution of contracts and maintain accurate contract records and documentation.
•	Liaise with clients, subcontractors, suppliers, and internal stakeholders regarding contractual matters.
•	Review project progress and identify contractual risks, delays, or compliance issues, and recommend appropriate solutions.
•	Monitor project costs, contract budgets, and payment schedules in collaboration with project managers and finance teams.
•	Prepare progress claims, payment certificates, contract reports, and commercial correspondence.
•	Assist in procurement activities, supplier evaluations, and subcontractor management.
•	Ensure all contract administration activities comply with company procedures, legislative requirements, and Australian Standards.
•	Maintain confidential contract records and support audits when required.
•	Follow workplace health and safety policies, company procedures, and quality management systems.

Skills and Experience
•	Bachelor's degree or relevant qualification in Construction Management, Engineering, Business, Commerce, or a related field.
•	Minimum 1-2 years of full-time experience as a Contract Administrator or in a similar commercial or project administration role.
•	Experience within the mining, engineering, construction, or industrial sectors is highly regarded.
•	Strong understanding of contract administration principles, procurement processes, and project delivery.
•	Ability to interpret contracts, technical specifications, and commercial documentation.
•	Excellent negotiation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
•	High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
•	Strong written and verbal communication skills.
•	Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and contract management or project management software.

What We Offer
•	Full-time, permanent employment.
•	Competitive salary of $90,000 – $120,000 per annum.
•	Opportunities to work on major mining, shutdown, engineering, and industrial projects.
•	Ongoing professional development and career progression.
•	Supportive team environment with long-term career opportunities.

Do you want to be part of South Australia's largest and leading health infrastructure project?

The State Government is committed to building a bigger and better hospital for South Australian women, babies, children, young people, and families.

The multi-billion dollar, once in a generation, project will provide a new modern facility for our future communities by 2031.

Located in the Adelaide BioMed City precinct, it will have more beds, theatres, and greater emergency capacity - and increased scope for future expansion.

Healthy environments are an important element of the project as we set out to build one of the first all-electric public hospitals in Australia.

The Project Manager is responsible for coordinating and undertaking the planning, delivery and review of complex healthcare related building projects and programs to time, cost and quality and ensuring projects meet the objectives and requirement of the government and Agency.

Smart Hill Constructions Pty Ltd 
(Reso Scaffold)
16 Prospect Place, Boronia VIC 3155

Full Time Architectural Draftsperson
$95,000 + superannuation

Summary
Smart Hill Construction Pty Ltd, trading as Reso Scaffold, is a growing construction company specialising in residential, commercial and industrial building projects. As the business continues to expand its design-and-construct capability, the company requires an experienced Architectural Draftsperson to prepare detailed architectural documentation, support project planning and coordinate technical drawings throughout the construction process.

Our Architectural Draftsperson will be responsible for preparing architectural drawings and construction documentation, interpreting design concepts, coordinating technical information and supporting the delivery of residential and commercial construction projects. The position provides specialised drafting support across the business and contributes to efficient project delivery, design coordination and regulatory compliance.

Duties and Responsibilities

Design Documentation and Drafting
•	Prepare architectural drawings, plans, elevations, sections and detailed construction documentation using CAD, Revit and BIM software
•	Translate architectural concepts, sketches and design specifications into accurate technical drawings for construction purposes
•	Revise and update drawings to reflect design changes, engineering requirements and client variations throughout project deliver

Project Documentation and Coordination
•	Prepare documentation required for planning approvals, building permits and construction documentation packages
•	Coordinate architectural drawings with structural, civil, mechanical and other consultant documentation to minimise design conflicts
•	Maintain project drawing registers, revision histories and document control throughout each stage of construction

Technical Design Support
•	Interpret building codes, Australian Standards and planning requirements when preparing architectural documentation
•	Assist with material selections, construction detailing and specification preparation to support project outcomes
•	Produce 3D models, presentation drawings and visual representations where required to assist project coordination and client communication

Stakeholder Liaison
•	Liaise with Architects, engineers, project managers, consultants and clients to clarify design requirements and technical information
•	Coordinate drawing revisions and technical documentation arising from project meetings and consultant feedback
•	Support communication between design and construction teams to facilitate efficient project delivery

Quality Assurance and Compliance
•	Review drawings to ensure accuracy, completeness and compliance with project specifications and applicable regulations
•	Maintain drawing standards, templates and documentation procedures in accordance with company quality systems
•	Assist in resolving design documentation issues during construction and support continuous improvement of drafting processes

Assessment Criteria
•	A relevant qualification in Architectural Drafting, Building Design, Architectural Technology, Architectural Interior Design or a closely related discipline, or relevant industry experience
•	At least three years of relevant experience preparing architectural drawings and construction documentation for residential and/or commercial building projects
•	Demonstrated proficiency using computer-aided drafting software such as AutoCAD, Revit or other comparable CAD/BIM platforms
•	Experience preparing and revising floor plans, elevations, sections, construction details and other technical documentation
•	Ability to interpret architectural concepts, engineering drawings and technical specifications and translate them into accurate construction documentation
•	Ability to communicate and coordinate drawings with architects, engineers, consultants and construction personnel throughout project delivery
•	Understanding of construction methods, building materials and document control procedures
•	Experience managing drawing revisions, version control and project documentation
•	Strong attention to detail with the ability to produce accurate and high-quality technical drawings
•	Well-developed communication and organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines
•	Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with all levels of stakeholders


How to apply:

Applications open on 13 July 2026 and close on 12 August 2026 

Please send your CV to info@businessnest.com.au. Please include the job role title in your email.

Facility Manager

Location: Brisbane, Queensland
Employment Type: Full-Time

$72,000 to $94,000 per annum plus Superannuation

We are seeking a Facility Manager to assist with the coordination and administration of commercial agreements and project-related documentation.

The Facility Manager is responsible for managing the delivery of commercial cleaning services across a portfolio of client sites, ensuring contractual obligations are met while maintaining high standards of quality, safety, and customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities:

•	Plan, coordinate and oversee cleaning operations across multiple commercial, industrial and government client sites. 
•	Develop operational plans, staffing schedules and site allocations to ensure services are delivered efficiently and in accordance with client requirements. 
•	Lead, supervise and support site supervisors and cleaning personnel, including recruitment, induction, training, performance management and ongoing development. 
•	Build and maintain positive working relationships with clients by conducting regular meetings, responding to service requests and proactively resolving operational issues. 
•	Carry out routine site inspections to assess service quality, identify areas requiring improvement and implement corrective action where necessary. 
•	Ensure sufficient labour, equipment and cleaning consumables are available to meet operational requirements and coordinate procurement where required. 
•	Monitor financial performance of service contracts, including labour costs, material usage and operational expenditure, and recommend measures to improve efficiency and profitability. 
•	Coordinate the mobilisation of new cleaning contracts, including workforce planning, equipment deployment and implementation of site-specific procedures. 
•	Develop and implement operational procedures that promote consistent service delivery across all managed sites. 
•	Ensure all cleaning activities are conducted in accordance with workplace health and safety requirements, environmental standards and company policies. 
•	Investigate client concerns, workplace incidents and service failures, and implement preventative measures to minimise recurrence. 
•	Prepare operational reports, service performance reviews and management recommendations to support business planning and continuous improvement. 
•	Work closely with senior management to identify opportunities for business growth, contract expansion and improved service delivery. 

Requirements:

Applicants should demonstrate:

•	A bachelor's degree or higher qualification in Business, Management, Facilities Management or a related discipline, or equivalent industry experience in a supervisory or management role within the commercial cleaning or facilities services sector. 
•	Proven experience managing multiple commercial cleaning contracts or facilities service operations.

Company: Dharma Bhakti Group Pty Ltd t/a Sunrise Custom Homes
Position Title: Architectural Draftsperson
Location: Adelaide, South Australia, 3061
Salary: AUD 79,500 to 82,000 + Super

About the Business:
Sunrise Custom Homes are Adelaide’s trusted custom home builders. They specialise in fully customisable homes and work closely with each client to bring their vision to life. Whether you’re building your first home or creating an investment property, their expertise and passion ensure your dream becomes a reality.

About the Role:
They are seeking a skilled and motivated Architectural Draftsperson to join their team. This hands-on position requires strong technical capability in drafting and documentation, along with a commitment to accuracy and high-quality design outcomes. The ideal candidate will be proficient in industry-standard drafting software and confident in reading, interpreting, and producing detailed architectural drawings. You’ll play a key role in transforming concepts into build-ready documentation, contributing directly to the delivery of custom homes.

Minimum Requirements:
Diploma or Advanced Diploma in Building Design, Architectural Drafting, Building Design Technology or a related discipline, or an equivalent qualification.
Minimum 1–3 years' experience in architectural drafting or building design within Australian residential construction projects.

Key Responsibilities:
Prepare detailed architectural drawings, construction documentation and working drawings for residential dwellings, custom homes, renovations and property development projects using CAD and Revit software.
Develop concept drawings, floor plans, elevations, sections and detailed construction documentation based on client requirements, architectural designs and engineering specifications.
Produce accurate working drawings in accordance with the National Construction Code (NCC), relevant Australian Standards and local council planning requirements.
Prepare detailed documentation including structural layouts, site plans, floor plans, roof plans, drainage layouts, service layouts and construction details for residential projects.
Modify and customise existing home designs and floor plans to suit client preferences, site conditions, budget requirements and regulatory requirements.
Coordinate drawings and documentation with architects, engineers, building designers, surveyors, certifiers, energy assessors, consultants, builders and project managers to ensure design accuracy and project consistency.
Liaise with clients and project stakeholders to gather project information and translate design concepts into accurate technical drawings.
Prepare documentation required for Development Applications (DA), Planning Approvals, Building Approvals, Council submissions and other statutory approval processes.
Review architectural, structural and engineering drawings to identify inconsistencies, drafting errors and construction issues prior to project commencement.
Amend, revise and update drawings based on client feedback, council requirements, consultant recommendations, engineering input and design changes throughout the design and construction process.
Assist with project coordination, planning approvals and construction documentation throughout all stages of residential projects.
Prepare schedules for doors, windows, finishes, fixtures and fittings to support construction documentation and procurement.
Assist in preparing material quantities, preliminary cost estimates and design documentation for tendering and project planning purposes.
Conduct site measurements and inspections where required to verify existing conditions and ensure drafting accuracy for renovations, custom homes and development projects.
Collaborate with construction supervisors, site teams and project managers to resolve design-related queries during construction and issue updated documentation where required.
Maintain accurate electronic records of drawings, revisions, project documentation and version control using the company's document management systems.
Research and apply current building regulations, planning policies, residential construction methods and sustainable design principles to ensure ongoing compliance and improve project outcomes.

Essential Skills
Proficient in CAD and Revit software for producing accurate architectural drawings and construction documentation.
Strong understanding of residential construction methods, detailing, building systems and construction processes.
Thorough knowledge of the National Construction Code (NCC), Australian Standards and local council planning requirements.
Ability to interpret architectural drawings, engineering plans, technical specifications and consultant documentation.
Strong attention to detail with the ability to prepare accurate, compliant and high-quality documentation.
Excellent communication and coordination skills with the ability to work effectively with clients, engineers, consultants, builders, site teams and project managers.
Strong organisational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Sound problem-solving skills and the ability to identify and resolve drafting and design issues throughout project delivery.

How to Apply:
To apply for this position, please email your resume to info@nextgentalent.com.au. Please note that only short-listed candidates will be contacted, and your application will be treated as strictly confidential
